title: Avoid non-essential travel: India's advisory for 3 African nations amid Ebola surge
desc: As the World Health Organisation (WHO) has declared the Ebola outbreak in Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan a public health emergency concern, India advises its citizens not to travel to these countries.
